verdict.rationale: First-party docs show declarative components whose script runs per component instance, with local reactive state via $state that is updated like a plain variable, derived values, effects, and component-scoped CSS, all of which make components encapsulated and stateful. Community reports confirm composition at scale: one team migrated a huge, complex React app, and another used the Context system to share state across components. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the composition mechanics themselves (props, child components, snippets/slots), and the pack's composition evidence is mostly community-sourced.
